messages:
maria: Heads-up — p95 for /v1/generate jumped ~120ms in the dashboard around the time we flipped the new routing weights. Screenshot: https://img.redwood/example.png
kevin: thanks, any idea which slice? endpoint, region, or model variant?
sasha: looks like endpoint-level only. I compared p50/p95 for the same route; p50 barely moved. p99 noisy but expected.
maria: exact query used in the console: `SELECT pctile(0.5, latency), pctile(0.95, latency) FROM metrics WHERE route='/v1/generate' GROUP BY origin`
alex_r: are retries included? last time retries inflated p95. Also did the routing change alter the sample origin from "proxy" to "server"? that would change merge semantics.
jordan: I dug into traces — requests routed to variant-b had more long tails, but origin tag on samples was sometimes missing after the fanout. suspect sampling provenance lost when fallback happens.
ops-bot: incident-alert: routing-weight-change detected at 1708088023, affected cluster us-east-1-gpu-pool.
console-bot: deploy: dashboard-query updated by @alex_r in staging (PR: #4521).
sasha: tl;dr: our aggregation logic uses t-digest rollups keyed by (route, origin). If origin is blank, we merge into default bucket and distort percentiles. routing tweak caused a small set of requests to lose origin metadata.
kevin: ok — options: 1) fix instrumentation to preserve origin, 2) change rollup to treat missing origin as a separate key (so it doesn't contaminate others), 3) annotate UI with a provenance badge so users know sample origin mix.
maria: for now can we add a temporary filter to the dashboard to exclude samples with origin=null so product dashboards are stable?
alex_r: done in staging — added `WHERE origin IS NOT NULL` to the p95 panel. Also pushed a quick tooltip explaining sample provenance.
jordan: I'll file a follow-up to add provenance enforcement in the ingestion pipeline (issue #7890). We should also add unit tests for t-digest merge behavior when keys are missing.
sasha: note: this also affects quota accounting if origin is used for routing-based quotas. verify billing pipeline too.
kevin: I'll own the ingestion fix. plan: preserve origin at the edge (add fallback origin=proxy if missing), add unit test + e2e to ensure percentiles stable after fanout. target patch in this week's sprint.
maria: awesome — once ingestion patch lands, can we remove the `origin IS NOT NULL` filter and revert tooltip? postmortem needed.
alex_r: will coordinate rollback. assigning todo list in the PR.
console-bot: checklist updated: add provenance badge (UI), add dashboard filter rollback, ingestion patch deploy (staging->prod).
maria: thanks team. small thing: can we show p95 both with and without retry inclusion so product folks understand sensitivity?
kevin: good call, will add toggles in the panel.
sasha: also: add a short note in the runbook about fallback-induced missing-tags. saved us time today. :+1:
maria: filed final follow-ups and added owners. closing thread once the ingestion PR is merged.
